title: Elf Bar ElfLiq Apple Peach Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Apple Peach from ElfLiq’s range of nic salt e-liquids is a delicious treat for fruit lovers thanks to its uncanny blend of juicy, sun-ripened peaches and crisp, tangy apples. Together they create a rich, sweet taste of late summer that is easily an all-day vape for lovers of mouth-watering fruit flavours. Elfliq e-liquids are Elf Bar’s most iconic flavours in 10ml bottles of nicotine salt e-liquid. With a 50% VG / 50% PG concentration, Elfliq liquids produce a discreet amount of flavour-rich vapour with a smooth, comfortable throat hit, and provide rapid relief from nicotine cravings. Elfliq nicotine salt e-liquids are available in 10mg or 20mg nicotine strength and are ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
